body: I created #24299, but I am not sure how to test it (I couldn't reproduce the issue 😕).
@gkalpak I have tested the changes it works fine!
We're moving to Node.js 10 as our TypeScript & JavaScript language service runtime in the next release of Visual Studio, so it would be great to get this in. Thanks!
We've implemented a workaround in WebStorm, but we are really hoping to see the PR with the fix merged soon.
